correctness.rationale: Explicit incidence matrix gives full update; calculated ranks of powers 0-4, characteristic polynomial and unit-space fixed dimensions imply Jordan multiplicities. A constructed periodic vector distinguishes J4(1) from two J3(1) in the mixed case. Nilpotent block kernels give exact entry times; generalized eigenspace splitting gives uniform orbit basin factors. Verified 49 independent matrix profiles and 1,233,152 exhaustively traced binary states in eight small graphs. Finite checks corroborate, not replace, the all-size proof.

value.rationale: Complete subdivision of a biclique is a standard natural incidence graph; the fixed linear neighbor-sum update exhibits a non-obvious parity transition from extinction through 2-cycles to genuine 4-cycles. The full all-size Jordan and basin classification distinguishes the vertex-edge dynamics from its line-graph square factor; it supplies sharp relaxation and exact orbit statistics not merely a small finite enumeration. No downstream theorem is asserted.
